concept.title: Respite care for carers
concept.shortdesc: Services that give carers a break from caring, through respite care, breaks or day centres for the person cared for.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: care at home while the carer has a break
home care services: see (ongoing home care)
specialist care and support: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (care service rather than a break)
visiting and home help: see (befriending and practical home help)
